title: 第一卷 第5章 镇妖司来人第一卷 第6章 测试开始
lines: 天刚蒙蒙亮的时候，秦烈就睁开了眼睛。
经过一晚上的休息，他的精神也好了不少。
加了一点体质之后，效果还是很明显的。
至少现在他能感觉到，不像昨天那样坐都坐不起来了。
他又看了一眼被鼠妖抓伤的地方。
血已经彻底止住了，伤口边缘也没有昨晚那么红了。
虽然说离完全恢复还差那么一点点，但是正常活动已经没什么疼痛的感觉了。
屋里很安静，柳芸娘并没有睡在床上，而是趴在桌子边睡着了。
身上披着一件旧袄子，桌子上还放着昨晚擦血用过的布条。
应该是昨天晚上处理完那只鼠妖之后，又不放心秦烈，所以一直守在这边。
秦烈也没有叫醒她，昨天晚上折腾了大半夜，这女人估计也累坏了。
轻手轻脚地走下床，推门走了出里去。
外头冷风一吹，整个人倒是清醒了不少。
张家的小院子不大，院墙都是用泥巴垒起来的，有些地方已经开裂了。
墙角处堆着一垛柴火，旁边还放着一把劈柴用的柴刀。
秦烈走了过去，把柴刀拿在手里掂了掂。
然后拿起一根木柴，照着木柴就劈了下去。
倒不是秦烈想干活了，而是他昨天晚上已经花了3点家业值兑换了基础刀法。
现在也没有什么别的兵器了，只能先拿柴刀凑合凑合。
基础刀法光听名字就知道没有什么花架子，一共就三式。
劈，是最直接的杀法。
刀从上往下落，把肩膀、腰和腿的力气全部都压进刀口里。
不求好看，只求够狠。
一刀劈下去，能够劈开妖物的脑袋。
撩，是被妖物近身之后使用的。
妖物一般速度都很快，很多时候根本不给人挥刀的机会。
这个时候不能乱动，刀要瞄准妖物的腹部，从下往上撩。
只要撩中，就能把扑上来的妖物给逼开。
挡，是用来防御的。
用刀刃或者刀身挡住袭来的进攻。
content_en:
When it was just dawn, Qin Lie opened his eyes.
After a night's rest, his energy improved a lot.
After adding a little physical strength, the effect is still very obvious.
At least he can feel it now, unlike yesterday when he couldn't even sit up.
He took another look at the place scratched by the rat demon.
The bleeding has completely stopped, and the edges of the wound are not as red as they were last night.
Although it is still a little short of full recovery, there is no pain in normal activities.
The room was very quiet. Liu Yunniang did not sleep on the bed, but fell asleep lying on the table.
He was wearing an old coat, and on the table was the strip of cloth he had used to wipe blood last night.
It must be that after dealing with the rat demon last night, Qin Lie was worried about him, so he stayed here.
Qin Lie didn't wake her up. After working hard for most of the night last night, this woman was probably exhausted.
He walked out of bed quietly, opened the door and walked out.
As soon as the cold wind blew outside, the whole person felt quite sober.
The Zhang family's small courtyard is not big. The courtyard walls are made of mud and are cracked in some places.
There is a pile of firewood piled in the corner, and a hatchet for chopping firewood is placed next to it.
Qin Lie walked over, took the hatchet and weighed it in his hand.
Then he picked up a piece of firewood and chopped it down.
It wasn't that Qin Lie wanted to work anymore, but that he had already spent 3 points of family wealth to exchange for basic sword skills last night.
There are no other weapons now, so I can only make do with a hatchet.
Just by listening to the name, you can tell that the basic sword skills are not fancy. There are only three styles in total.
Hacking is the most direct way to kill.
The knife fell from top to bottom, pressing all the strength of the shoulders, waist and legs into the knife edge.
Not looking good, just being ruthless.
One slash of the knife can split the monster's head open.
Teasing is used after being approached by a monster.
Monsters are generally very fast and often don't give people a chance to swing their swords.
Don't move around at this time. The knife should be aimed at the monster's abdomen and lifted from bottom to top.
As long as you hit it, you can force the monster away from you.
Blocking is used for defense.
Use the blade or blade to block incoming attacks.
